_doc: Where each relying party keeps its copy of the canonical verifier (shared/auth-cloudflare.js). Read by scripts/auth-drift.mjs. Keyed by registry key (projects.config.mjs). Only projects whose host resolves are checked, so an offline app needs no row until it is restored, and a restored app with no row goes red. 'deviations' records a function that differs from canonical ON PURPOSE: the normalized sha256 it is expected to have, and why. Any other difference is drift. Rows: AUTH-DESIGN.md weakness #2.

hasProjectAccess.why: review is sensitive: a JWT with no projects claim is denied (canonical treats a missing claim as legacy full access)

boardreview.why: served by the same majordomo review-app worker as review (host-keyed behaviour)
